# Puijai Cancellation Service

> Puijai Service Cancellation Portal and Support Management for LINE AI Chatbot.

## Overview

Puijai Service Cancellation (ระบบศูนย์ขอยกเลิกการใช้งานปุยใจ) provides an automated cancellation and feedback management system for the Puijai AI chatbot on LINE.

## Links

- [Puijai Cancellation App](https://puijai-cancellation-app.vercel.app/): Cancellation request portal for LINE AI Chatbot
- [Sitemap](https://puijai-cancellation-app.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): XML Sitemap
